sections.section_title: GPIO port bit reset register (GPIOx_BRR) (x = A to H)
sections.text_helper: Section 11.4.11 "GPIO port bit reset register (GPIOx_BRR) (x = A to H)" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 354.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 BRy: Port x reset IO pin y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are write-only. A read to these bits returns the value 0x0000.
0: No action on the corresponding ODy bit
1: Reset the corresponding ODy bit
Note: The bit is reserved and must be kept to reset value when the corresponding I/O is not
available on the selected package.
